## DataCite Corpus - Exploratory Analysis



```{r dc_summary}
## FUNCTION: exp_summary - argument dat (dataframe)
## Argument dat takes a dataframe. Column names are assumed to
## match the columns provided in the DataCite Corpus as of 
## 11 October 2026. Documentation and file downloads available 
## at https://zenodo.org/records/16901115

dc_summary <- function(dat) {
  ## Returns descriptive statistics of the data file - number
  ## of rows, number & proportion of rows with publication DOIs, 
  ## number & proportion of rows with a 'created' date,
  ## number & proportion of rows with publication dates,
  ## number & proportion of rows with a funder listed.
  
  summarylist <- dat |> summarise(
    n = nrow(dat),
    n_doi = str_detect(dat$publication, pattern = "doi") |> sum(na.rm = TRUE),
    n_created_date = sum(1 - is.na(dat$created), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_pub_date = sum(1 - is.na(dat$publishedDate), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_funders = sum(1 - is.na(dat$funders), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nih = str_detect(dat$funders, pattern = "(NIH)|(National Institutes of Health)") |> 
      sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  return(summarylist)
}
```

```{r do_dc_summary, eval=FALSE}

## calling with %dopar%.
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
  # Summary data across all datasets.
  data_summary <- data.frame(

    "n_funders" = c(),

# Compute summary descriptive statistics across summary_data.
  data_summary |> summarise(
    Size = sum(n),
    Num.DOI = sum(n_doi),
    Percent.DOI = (sum(n_doi) / sum(n)) * 100,
    Num.created = sum(n_created_date),
    Percent.created = (sum(n_created_date) / sum(n)) * 100,
    No.funders = (sum(n_funders)),
    Percent.funders = (sum(n_funders) / sum(n)) * 100,
    No.NIH.Funded = sum(n_nih)
    No.
  )
```
